He claims that the following two lines have the same pattern as one of those in the Initial Challenge. Which Group or Pair of lines does each line belong? Explain why.

  • Line 1 contains the points (1,4) and (3, 12)
  • Line 2 contains the points (1, 6) and (3, 14)

Several competing canoe rentals use expressions to represent the rental cost C.

  • C1 = 2.5 + 0.25t
  • C2 = 0.25(10 + t)
  • C3 = 0.25(10 + 10t)
  • C4 = 0.5(10 + 0.5t)
  1. Which plan(s) is the least expensive per minute?
  2. Describe the shape of each graph. What information about rental costs does the slope represent?
